skills.title: Luma Event Profile
skills.author: Specter
skills.body:
# Luma Event Profile

## Event
- Title: Hackathon: Building your own Agent LLM Wiki
- Platform: Luma
- Date: Saturday, May 16
- Time: 12:00 PM - 6:00 PM
- Location: Pebblebed, 1417 15th St, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Presented by: cognee
- Hosted by: cognee, Nicole Levin, Pebblebed VC, Sahar Mor, Marie Owens
- Attendees: 141
- Category: AI

## Actions Available
- Add to Calendar
- Invite a Friend
- Contact Host
- Report Event

## Prize Pool
- First: $800
- Second: $500
- Third: $200

## Schedule
- 12:00 PM — Doors open + Networking
- 12:30 PM — Opening remarks + partner demos
- 1:00 PM — Hacking begins
- 4:30 PM — Project Submission Deadline
- 5:00 PM — Finalist presentation & judging
- 5:30 PM — Awards ceremony
- 6:00 PM — Event wrap-up

## Partners
- Redis
- Pebblebed
